environment_note: Apple M1 Max host; Project builds, tests and other project CPU work were paused for measurement. Other desktop applications and an unrelated background Python workload remained active; no cache eviction or host resource isolation. Alternating adjacent baseline/candidate runs, three warmups and ten measured repetitions per lane.

method.cache: warm; inventory and warmups before measurement; no eviction
method.order: reverse lane order each round; baseline/candidate stay adjacent for each old path
method.wall: subprocess elapsed including time wrapper; excludes JSON checks and inventories
method.rss: standalone CLI peak resident bytes; macOS bytes or Linux GNU time KiB converted to bytes
method.limits: No universal speed claim or enforced CPU/RAM limit; host activity described separately.

transformations: Rephrase the project-work pause in environment_note without naming the development process; retain the same host and background-load limitations.
